name: Airborne
description: Forced-displacement crowd control: the unit is flung in a direction (knock up/back/aside/pull) and cannot move, attack, or cast for the duration; tenacity does not affect it.

name: Blind
description: The blinded unit's basic attacks miss (deal no damage, no on-hit effects) for the duration; attacks can still be declared.

name: Cripple
description: Reduces the target's total attack speed by a percentage for the duration (attack-speed slow); stacks multiplicatively.

name: Disarm
description: The disarmed unit cannot declare basic-attack commands for the duration; reloading (Graves/Jhin) is a related lockout, not a disarm.

name: Disrupt
description: Instant, duration-less effect that interrupts channeled and charged abilities; not itself a status/debuff.

name: Drowsy
description: Gradually slows the unit over its duration, then causes it to fall asleep; tenacity does not shorten it, slow resist weakens its slow component.

name: Sleep
description: Full disable (move/attack/cast/item actives) that ends prematurely when the sleeper takes damage; occurs after Drowsy.

name: Forced Action
description: Umbrella crowd-control family in which the victim loses control of its own movement/attacks (subtypes: Berserk, Charm, Flee, Taunt); ends early if the source dies (except Berserk).

name: Berserk
description: Forced action subtype: the unit must basic-attack a nearby unit (allies can be targeted) for the duration.

name: Charm
description: Forced action subtype: the unit walks toward the source with reduced movement speed for the duration.

name: Flee
description: Forced action subtype: the unit walks directly away from the source with reduced movement speed; 'Fear' is the deprecated name for the same effect.

name: Taunt
description: Forced action subtype: the unit must basic-attack the taunting source for the duration (attack commands inhibited, not disabled).

name: Ground
description: The grounded unit cannot activate movement spells (dashes, blinks, Flash, Recall) but can still walk and be displaced; commonly a persistent zone.

name: Kinematics
description: The unit is continually dragged toward a unit or location until reached; not an airborne/displacement effect and disables nothing by itself.

name: Knockdown
description: Instant, duration-less effect that interrupts a dash or airborne displacement and places the unit on the ground.

name: Nearsight
description: Reduces the unit's sight radius and removes vision of allies and external sources for the duration; tenacity does not affect it.

name: Root
description: The rooted unit cannot control movement or activate movement spells but can still attack, cast, and be displaced.

name: Silence
description: The silenced unit cannot cast abilities or activate item actives for the duration; interrupts channels.

name: Polymorph
description: Silences the unit and turns it into a helpless critter; Lulu's version also disarms and slows.

name: Slow
description: Reduces the unit's movement speed by a percentage or flat amount for the duration; only the strongest slow applies, and percentage slows cannot push MS below 110.

name: Stasis
description: Full disable that also makes the unit invulnerable and untargetable; cannot be cleansed, unaffected by tenacity, disables even summoner spells.

name: Stun
description: Full disable: cannot move, attack, cast, or activate items for the duration; interrupts channels and attack windups; reduced by tenacity.

name: Suspension
description: Stun variant (unique to Nami's Aqua Prison) that also pretends to be airborne so Yasuo's Last Breath can target the victim.

name: Suppression
description: Full disable that also blocks ALL summoner spells (including Cleanse) for the duration; unaffected by tenacity.

name: Immobilize
description: Buzzword for CC that removes control of movement: Airborne, Forced Action, Root, Sleep, Stasis, Stun (Suspension), Suppression; hard CC vs soft CC distinction.

name: Crowd Control Immunity
description: Status preventing any CC from being applied (already-applied CC keeps working); displacement immunity is the subset covering airborne/knockdown/kinematics/sleep/stasis.

name: Tenacity
description: Stat that reduces incoming CC durations by a percentage (not airborne, drowsy, nearsight, stasis, suppression); minimum 0.3s, stacks multiplicatively within groups A/B/C and additively across groups; negative tenacity lengthens CC.

name: Slow Resist
description: Stat that reduces the strength (percentage) of slows, including self-slows; stacks multiplicatively, does not affect flat MS reductions.

name: Slow Immunity
description: Status that prevents slows from being applied at all (stronger than 100% slow resist); also prevents Drowsy's slow but not the Sleep.

name: Cripple Immunity
description: Status that prevents cripple (attack-speed slow) effects from being applied.

name: Cleanse
description: Action that removes applicable crowd-control debuffs (and some summoner-spell debuffs); castable while disabled, but not under suppression/stasis; airborne forced movement and stasis are un-cleansable.

name: Brittle
description: Ornn's debuff: reduces the target's Tenacity by 30% and increases the duration of the next immobilizing crowd control. An interaction atom — applied by Ornn's abilities, affecting subsequent CC durations via the target's tenacity.

name: Channel
description: Ability state that can be cancelled by disruptive CC (Disrupt, silence, stun, etc.); charged abilities are channels toggled by two activations.

name: Lockout
description: Unit unable to perform certain actions because it is executing another action (e.g. Graves/Jhin reload); does not interact with CC mechanics.

name: Crowd Control Score
description: Post-game statistic scoring CC inflicted per second of debuff duration (e.g. 1 pt for stun/root/airborne, 0.5 for blind/ground, 0.16 for slow/cripple).

name: Dash
description: Movement that travels the intervening distance toward a direction/location/target; blocked by Ground/Root, interrupted by Knockdown/Airborne/Stasis, mostly cannot be cast while immobilized.

name: Blink
description: Instantaneous repositioning without traversing the space between; blocked by Ground/Root, can exit Veigar's Event Horizon, places unit at nearest passable terrain if targeted into a wall.

name: Lunge
description: Movement during a cast or empowered-attack animation to close range; distinct from dashes (does not trigger dash interactions).

name: Ghost
description: Summoner spell granting bonus movement speed (additive, ramping 24-48%) and ignoring unit collision for ~10s.

name: Movement Speed
description: Stat for travel rate (units/sec): base + flat bonuses, additive % bonuses, multiplicative bonuses, then highest slow, then soft caps; some abilities/items scale with the unit's MS.

name: Movement Speed Soft Caps
description: Soft caps on raw MS: 415-490 at 80%, above 490 at 50%; below 220 a floor formula applies and slows cannot push MS under 110.

name: Combat Status
description: State tracking whether a unit has dealt/received damage or CC from an enemy; out-of-combat typically triggers ~5s later and gates MS effects, boots, runes, and buffs.

name: Knockback
description: Forced displacement away from the source (Trait_KnockBack).

name: Untargetable
description: Cannot be selected by enemy abilities/attacks (Trait_Untargetable).
